meta.title: Contact Green Gate Advisory | Request a Climate Advisory Consultation
meta.description: Contact Green Gate Advisory to discuss carbon markets, CBAM, ETS, climate finance, nature-based solutions, climate policy or corporate sustainability.

hero.headline: Let's Discuss Your Climate and Environmental Priorities
hero.subheadline: Whether you are assessing CBAM exposure, exploring a carbon project, preparing a climate finance proposal or developing a corporate climate strategy, Green Gate Advisory can help you identify practical next steps. Share a brief overview of your needs and our team can discuss the appropriate scope of support.

intro.heading: Structured Discussion Across Eight Specialized Areas
intro.lead: Every advisory engagement begins with clarifying your operating context, statutory obligations, data availability, and strategic milestones.

areas.title: Carbon Market Development
areas.desc: Project feasibility, methodology selection, PDD drafting, and credit issuance pathways.

areas.title: CBAM Readiness
areas.desc: Exposure assessment, embedded emissions calculation, and supply-chain reporting.

areas.title: ETS & Carbon Pricing
areas.desc: Compliance readiness, allowance surrender management, and Article 6 transfers.

areas.title: Climate Finance Proposals
areas.desc: Concept note structuring, theory of change, and multilateral fund applications.

areas.title: Nature-Based Solutions
areas.desc: Ecosystem restoration, blue carbon, agroforestry, and biodiversity net gain.

areas.title: Environmental Policy & NDCs
areas.desc: National Adaptation Plans, policy review, and Paris Agreement transparency.

areas.title: Corporate Climate & ESG
areas.desc: Scope 1, 2, and 3 accounting, decarbonisation roadmaps, and reporting readiness.

areas.title: Training & Capacity Building
areas.desc: Customized technical workshops and institutional capability programmes.

intro.notice: Consultation discipline: All discussions are strictly preliminary and focused on scoping technical feasibility and regulatory requirements. We do not make speculative funding promises or guaranteed outcomes.
